title: A Lane Closed on the Highway
高速公路上封了一個車道
paras: At 5:30 on a {{weekday|weekday}} morning, the {{garage|garage}} at the Northline depot was already loud with engines. Tom Reyes, the dispatcher, stood at the whiteboard with a coffee, checking which vans in the company’s {{fleet|fleet}} were ready. Twenty-two of twenty-four were. The other two were waiting for new tires.
平日早上五點半，北線倉庫的車庫裡已經引擎聲隆隆。調度員湯姆・雷耶斯端著咖啡站在白板前，確認公司車隊裡有哪些貨車已經備妥。二十四輛裡有二十二輛可以出發，另外兩輛還在等換新輪胎。

Northline’s {{distribution|distribution}} work was simple to describe and hard to do: goods that arrived {{overnight|overnight}} from the port had to be on the road to forty stores before seven. Tom also kept two vans aside for the {{courier|courier}} service, which carried urgent packages across the city on the same day.
北線的配送工作說起來簡單，做起來很難：夜裡從港口運到的貨，必須在七點前上路，送往四十家門市。湯姆還另外留了兩輛車給快遞服務，專門在當天把緊急包裹送到市區各處。

At 6:10 his phone rang. Alicia, one of his best drivers, was stuck on the {{highway|highway}}. A truck had broken down and blocked the right {{lane|lane}}, and the traffic behind it had stopped completely. Tom opened the map, found a back route along Mill Road, and told her where to turn off. Then he called the first three stores to warn them she would be late.
六點十分，他的手機響了。他最優秀的司機之一艾莉西亞被困在高速公路上。一輛卡車拋錨，擋住了右側車道，後面的車流完全停住了。湯姆打開地圖，找到一條沿著米爾路的替代路線，告訴她在哪裡下交流道。接著他打電話給前三家門市，提醒他們她會晚到。
She arrived twenty minutes behind schedule, and every store had its delivery by eight. Tom crossed the last name off the whiteboard and finally drank his coffee, which had been cold since six.
她比預定時間晚了二十分鐘到達，每家門市在八點前都收到了貨。湯姆把白板上最後一個名字劃掉，終於喝起了他的咖啡，那杯咖啡從六點起就已經涼了。
